title: CosOverHere
summary: Full-stack map and calendar for cosplay events and spots across the Nordics & Baltics.
overview: CosOverHere (formerly CosoraAtlas) is my first solo full-stack web project. It gathers cosplay events, cosplay-friendly places and performance practice spots across the Nordic and Baltic countries on one map and calendar, with localization support. The backend imports events from open data sources. Visitors can also submit through the form, selectively approved by admins.

title: Escape Room Engine
summary: C++ & OpenGL engine for building and playing 3D escape rooms, with a level editor.
overview: [WIP] A 3D game engine written from scratch in modern C++ and OpenGL. It is a small escape-room creation platform: you build a room in the built-in level editor, it is saved as a JSON file, and the engine loads and plays any room. The sample level is a cosplay convention green room you have to escape from.

title: Flair UE5 Thesis
overview: My master's thesis at the University of Tartu, made for Artineering. I built the first version of Flair, Artineering's non-photorealistic rendering (NPR) toolset from Maya, for Unreal Engine 5: a C++ Slate shelf, Qt dialogs talking to UE5 through its Python API, and HLSL ports of Flair's shaders. Artists can apply style and material presets like Blur, Cel, Sobel and Pixel without writing shaders, and five usability tests with UE5 artists and developers confirmed the design.

title: Distributed Message Bus
summary: Event-driven microservices over RabbitMQ with gRPC and Docker.
overview: A set of event-driven microservices communicating over RabbitMQ, with gRPC for synchronous calls and PostgreSQL for persistence. The whole stack is containerised and reproducible with a single docker compose up.

title: Unity Games on itch.io
summary: Four small Unity games I developed, playable in the browser.
overview: A collection of four small games I developed in Unity, all playable in the browser on itch.io: a Color Switch clone made as a recruitment coding task for HXRC, KebabLala, a kebab shop simulation started at Ludum Dare 53, Grove Dome for the B&W Game Jam 2022, and Always: Starry Sky, a merge puzzle game from 2021. I was the developer on every one of them.

title: Occupational Therapy
summary: An XR occupational therapy scenario in VLL, our Virtual Learning Platform.
overview: One of the many XR scenarios in VLL, our Virtual Learning Platform. I worked on full-stack features across the NestJS backend, the student and teacher apps and our shared SDK, multiplayer classrooms with Photon Fusion, and NPC characters driven by state machines and Convai conversations. The project is confidential, so only the video is shared.
